name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (CLCSS)
summary: Provides an upfront capital subsidy of 15% on institutional credit for technology upgradation of Micro and Small Enterprises.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Upfront subsidy of 15% on institutional credit up to Rs. 1.0 Crore (i.e. subsidy cap of Rs. 15.00 lakh) for identified sectors and technologies.

criteria.description: Applicant must be registered as a Micro or Small Enterprise under Udyam.
criteria.source_quote: Any Micro and Small Enterprise (MSE) availing institutional credit to buy new Plant & Machinery approved under the scheme.

criteria.description: The plant and machinery being financed must be new, and of a make/model on the scheme's approved technology list. Second-hand or fabricated machinery is disqualifying.
criteria.source_quote: Second hand & fabricated will not be eligible.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register on the official Udyam portal
Apply for a term loan at a designated PLI
Prepare a detailed technical plan for the technology upgrade

windows.notes: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis via Primary Lending Institutions.

benefits.description: Upfront capital subsidy of 15% on institutional credit
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Subsidy is disbursed after the loan is sanctioned and evaluated by Nodal Agencies.
benefits.source_quote: Upfront subsidy of 15% on institutional Credit upto Rs. 1.0 Crore (i.e. subsidy cap of Rs. 15.00 lakh)
